map.基于绞盘（Capstan）公式估算缓降器在不同包绕圈数与摩擦系数下的控制力与理论: Based on the capstan formula, estimate the control force and theoretical descent speed of a descender at different wrap counts and friction coefficients.
map.绳索摩擦下降按欧拉-艾特尔魏因公式：T_load/T_hold = e^(μ·θ: Rope friction descent by the Euler-Eytelwein formula: T_load/T_hold = e^(μ·θ), θ=2πn (n = wraps); control tension T_ctrl = m·g/e^(μθ); acceleration a = g/e^(μθ), final speed v=√(2ah), braking share (1−1/e^(μθ))×100%.
map.摩擦系数 μ 与绳索材质、湿度相关：干燥尼龙约 0.15~0.25，潮湿可降至: The friction coefficient μ depends on the rope material and moisture: dry nylon is about 0.15-0.25 and can drop to 0.1 when wet.
map.包绕圈数越多，控制力越小、下降越慢，但圈数过多易卡死绳索。: The more wraps, the smaller the control force and the slower the descent, but too many wraps can jam the rope.
map.理论速度为匀加速估算，实际由操作者实时控制，不应超过 2~3 m/s。: The theoretical speed is a uniform-acceleration estimate; in practice the operator controls it in real time and it should not exceed 2-3 m/s.
map.救援作业必须使用经认证的缓降器与安全绳，本结果仅供训练参考。: Rescue operations must use certified descenders and safety ropes; this result is for training reference only.

map.按默认参数（载荷 80 kg、包绕 2 圈、摩擦系数 0.2）：理论下降速度 3: With the default parameters (load 80 kg, 2 wraps, friction coefficient 0.2): theoretical descent speed 3.99 m/s, descent acceleration 0.795 m/s², descent time 5.02 s; control-side force 63.6 N, capstan braking ratio 12.35, gravity-braking share 91.9%. The tool rates it 'speed too fast', recommending more wraps or a reduced load to slow the descent.
map.为什么速度偏快要加包绕圈数？: Why add wraps when the speed is too fast?
The more wraps, the longer the rope contacts the anchor point, the stronger the friction braking and the slower the descent; 2 wraps at μ=0.2 already reach 3.99 m/s, so in practice 3-4 wraps are often used for a more controllable speed.
map.重力制动比例高说明什么？: What does a high gravity-braking share indicate?
map.重力制动比例高表示系统主要依赖绳索摩擦而非机械制动来控速，对绳索与支点磨损大、可: A high gravity-braking share means the system relies mainly on rope friction rather than mechanical braking to control speed, which wears the rope and anchor point more and is less controllable; mechanical braking should be added or the wrap pattern adjusted.
